text: Phase 2 substantive work complete, R CMD check in flight. (1) Structured rank-1 pair-difference queries (R/query-structured.R) replace the dense packed query everywhere: atom stage, coherent-from-first-moments, and support-streamed metric kernels all take the (u'L)∘(u'R) row-difference path; the O(q^4) eager matrix no longer exists on either route (projected route now uses direct packed-index gather). (2) Public selected-pairs API: rdm(plan, pairs=). (3) Memory accounting includes the live query representation (structured payload + pair workspace) threaded through .compiler_memory_plan and the kernel memory plan. (4) Cheap wins: idempotent source-session close guard; validation-memo retention documented honestly with .validation_memo_bytes() probe. (5) Gate 5 delivered: benchmarks/run-query-first-scale.R + committed results + opt-in test + scale.yml timeout bump. Measured at q=100/1080 searchlights: selected-100-pairs 0.23s (20x cheaper than full), full fused 4.6s vs materialized 18.3s (4x faster; audit baseline was 3.9x SLOWER at 54s), oracle 4.4e-16, route ids stable, memory gate under 512MiB vs ~196MiB dense query avoided. Decisions: contrast-on-form double read left as-is (two disjoint stores; combining saves loop overhead only); checkpoint/scheduler/.tiled_contraction wiring deferred to Phase 3 attic-or-wire pass.
